author: Limidi
body:
Hi! I am Here with my second map.

ENDER CITY CTF
I love making maps, so I created another one, This one is a CTF, and It is called ender City. I made a backstory up for this one!

*This map is not finished.










BackStory: Long Long ago, There was a busling town called End. End was located at the far northern corner of the minecraft world. North World was unsettling and war-torn, because of the Great Desert wars of 1603 BCE. There was a constant struggle for power all around End, but End itself was perfectly fine, with its 50 foot high walls. These high walls encircled the city, but they had a weakness. The gates leading into North End and South End, were exposed since they could not import wood becuase of the war. The yellow side, Or the north, often exported an odd substance called Endstone. This was uniquely found in the end, and all the other provences were jeaulous of this beautiful material. The city of end was richer than ever, but a looming conflict grew outside the walls. There had been talk of a machine, capable of throwing cities to other worlds. In the closed world of End, people did not believe it. One thursday Morning, at about 8 O'Clock, A rumbling noise was heard outside the mighty city walls. It was an army of 20,000. This was way more than the 5,000 people of End, but they decided to put up a fight. For 7 days and 7 nights, there was bitter fighting in End. The northern armies of Wither, having won the power struggle, Atttacked the weakened city on the 8th night. The moon was new, and the stars were covered by the endless clouds. Wither and his army rushed the city gates, and pillaged the city. The mayor was in shock, and weeped to himself as he raised the white flag above the dual town halls. Wither then pulled out a device. The people stood in awe. Then, a wooshing noise. All of a sudden, End was in a new place. This did not look like World. Over the years, the people changed. they grew tall and black, with long arms. They were threatened daily by an awful dragon. They decided to name this dimension End, after the town that used to be.

Map Download: https://www.mediafire.com/?8451f43h4dwer4r

Igmur Album: http://imgur.com/a/6EYSf

This Map Is not finished, But let me know what you think down below! I am updating the map based on suggestions, and wehn the community likes it, I will work on the XML. If you want to help on the XML, kype me @ liam.dietrich20 or email at liam.dietrich@me.com. Or IG. I will add you as an author. Thanks!

replies.author: Spartemex
replies.body:
I like the block pallette, but is it played across those two circles? Would people have to use those bridges to get across? For CTF because you can't edit terrain usually it's best to have an open map. Maybe if you made one big circle. But you're on the right track! Some more pictures would be nice. Looks sweet other wise :)

Oh, and it's awesome you gave it a backstory!
